episode_summary: In this episode, Alex Maldonado shares strategies for helping first-time buyers overcome closing cost hurdles by using seller credits. He also discusses the importance of optimizing Google business profiles for better lead generation and shares insights into bilingual marketing for the Hispanic community. Learn how to leverage these tactics to grow your real estate business.
